beats.label: S1 · The pit and the promise
beats.text: Nurse Ann Perkins asks Pawnee's parks department to fill in the construction pit her boyfriend Andy fell into. Leslie Knope promises to build a park there instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season-long project, Leslie's ambition, and the Ann/Andy pairing that shapes everything after.

beats.label: S1 · Getting Ron on board
beats.text: Ron Swanson, Leslie's libertarian boss, refuses to greenlight the park. Mark Brendanawicz, a city planner and Leslie's old fling, calls in a favour to push the approval through.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Ron's anti-government stance and Mark's role as Leslie's inside man and lingering romantic thread.

beats.label: S1 · Public opinion turns
beats.text: Leslie's subcommittee — Tom Haverford, Mark, and intern April Ludgate — canvasses the neighbourhood, but the town meeting fills with opponents. Leslie filibusters to keep the project alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Tom and April, and shows the park is barely surviving public resistance rather than sailing through.

beats.label: S1 · Mark and the reporter
beats.text: Leslie invites a local reporter to profile the pit, then finds out Mark slept with her. Ann talks Mark into softening the piece, but Leslie is left stung by how casually he moved on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real sting in the Leslie/Mark thread and Ann stepping in as Leslie's friend, not just a constituent.

beats.label: S1 · Ethics scrape, Ron covers
beats.text: Leslie crashes an after-hours boys' club, breaks a gift-basket rule, and April posts a video of herself drinking underage on the parks website. Ron defends her at the ethics hearing and she gets off with a warning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Ron will quietly protect Leslie despite hating the process, and establishes April as the intern who causes trouble.

beats.label: S1 · Andy's lie exposed
beats.text: Ann discovers Andy's leg casts should have come off weeks ago and that he has been faking to keep her waiting on him. Their relationship is on the rocks going into the finale.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cracks open the Ann/Andy couple, which frees Ann up and starts the drift that reorders the group's pairings.

beats.label: S1 · Mark makes his move, falls in
beats.text: A drunk Mark tries to kiss Leslie by the pit; she refuses because he is drunk. Moments later he stumbles into the pit itself, ending the season on Leslie's unfilled park.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves Leslie/Mark unresolved and literally puts a man back in the hole she has spent six episodes trying to fill.

cliffhanger.text: Leslie's park is approved but unbuilt, the pit is still a pit, and the man who just fell into it is the same man she nearly kissed. Ann and Andy's relationship is quietly falling apart.
questions: Will Leslie ever actually get the park built on Lot 48?
Is there anything real between Leslie and Mark, or is he just a mess she should walk away from?
Now that Ann knows Andy has been faking, does she stay with him?

characters.name: Leslie Knope
characters.line: Mid-level parks department bureaucrat whose entire career is riding on turning Lot 48 into a park.
characters.note: Optimistic, ambitious, and quietly hung up on Mark.

characters.name: Ann Perkins
characters.line: A local nurse who came in as a constituent and has become Leslie's closest friend outside the department.
characters.note: Dating Andy, but has just learned he has been lying about his injury.

characters.name: Andy Dwyer
characters.line: Ann's slacker musician boyfriend who fell into the pit and then faked needing casts so Ann would keep taking care of him.
characters.note: That con has just been exposed.

characters.name: Ron Swanson
characters.line: Leslie's boss and the parks director, a libertarian who believes government should do as little as possible.
characters.note: Quietly protects Leslie even as he opposes her projects.

characters.name: Mark Brendanawicz
characters.line: A city planner and Leslie's former one-night stand who greased the wheels for the park approval.
characters.note: Cynical about his own job; tried to kiss Leslie while drunk and fell into the pit.

characters.name: Tom Haverford
characters.line: Leslie's parks department deputy, more interested in schmoozing developers and gaming his boss than doing the work.
characters.note: Ambitious in a purely self-serving way.

characters.name: April Ludgate
characters.line: The department's disaffected underage intern, already causing minor scandals — the drinking video that triggered Leslie's ethics warning was hers.
